title: Dog Night, 2001 · after
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The morning after two years: the dog asleep on the blanket in the back room, the leash still on, Wood drawing him. The first hand-on-the-dog panel was a year ago; this one is a pen on the paper instead.

panels.composition: The back room in morning light. BARNABY asleep on the blanket with the leash still clipped on.

image.prompt: a small dog asleep on a folded blanket with its leash still clipped on in morning light, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: WOOD on the floor with a pad, drawing him.

image.prompt: a young man sitting on the floor drawing a sleeping dog on a pad, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The pad: the dog, in six lines.

image.prompt: a sketch pad with a sleeping dog drawn in six quick lines, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: WOOD unclipping the leash without waking him.

image.prompt: a young man carefully unclipping a leash from a sleeping dog's collar, brush-pen black and white

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: A pen on the paper instead of a hand.
